title: bun.lock platform-package pins do not update with a version bump, so it must be patched reactively each release
description:
bun.lock pins all six @opum-ai/quest-<platform> optionalDependencies to a literal version -- as of the 0.6.2 state, lines 21-26 (the root packages optionalDependencies block) and 53-63 (the resolved package entries). A version bump to package.json does not touch these; only running `bun install` regenerates them. This broke `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in CI the moment the 0.6.2 platform packages became resolvable on the registry, and was fixed once as a one-off patch rather than as a repeatable release-procedure step (see QCLI-271s implementation notes, the session that hit and fixed it, which says plainly this will recur). Searched the tracker before filing: QCLI-131 is the only other bun.lock task and it is Done, covering a different and earlier staleness cause -- this recurrence currently belongs to no one.

Not scoped to 0.7.0. But bun.lock IS one of the files a 0.7.0 version bump has to touch regardless of whether this task is ever done: whoever performs that bump must run `bun install` to repoint these six pins before `bun run check` / `check:packages` will pass, independent of this tasks own resolution.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The release procedure documentation (e.g. docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md) states explicitly that bun.lock must be regenerated via bun install as part of every version bump, not rediscovered by a failing CI run each time

A decision is made and recorded on whether this should be enforced by a check (failing closed when bun.lock platform-package versions do not match package.json version) or remains a documented manual step, with the reasoning either way

plan: 1. DECISION (AC2), recorded in the runbook: enforce with a check that fails closed. Reason: the documented manual step already existed and did not prevent the drift, and CI's frozen install passes at bump time and fails only after publish, on an unrelated PR. The remedy (bun install) works before publish, so blocking the bump PR costs one command.

2. scripts/check-lockfile-pins.mjs: parse bun.lock (JSONC with trailing commas) and require every @opum-ai/quest-<platform> pin in the root workspace optionalDependencies, and any resolved packages entry, to equal package.json version. Fail closed when it reads fewer than six pins. The message names bun install as the fix.

3. Gate it in bun run test (so source-gates runs it on the bump PR itself) with a test against the real files, plus unit cases: stale, missing, resolved-entry mismatch, zero pins read, clean. Add a check:lockfile script.
4. Runbook (AC1): replace the not-yet-automated paragraph with the bump step and what the gate does.
5. Mutation check, bun run check, lore check, then close in the same PR citing concluded runs.
implementationNotes: MEASURED 2026-09-25, bun 1.3.14, in a scratch copy of package.json and bun.lock (the repo was not touched). (1) Stale case: package.json and its six optionalDependencies bumped to an UNPUBLISHED 0.10.1 with bun.lock left at 0.10.0 pins. `bun install --frozen-lockfile --linker=isolated` exits 0 and leaves bun.lock byte-identical. CI's own frozen install is therefore BLIND at bump time: an unresolvable optional dependency is skipped, not compared. (2) Same staleness against a PUBLISHED version: package.json at 0.10.0 with the lock pinned at 0.9.0. Exit 1, "lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen". This is the 0.6.2 mechanism: the stale lock goes red only once the new version is on the registry, i.e. AFTER the release, on whatever PR runs next. (3) Remedy before publish: plain `bun install` on the stale copy exits 0 and rewrites exactly the six workspace pin lines (lines 21-26) to 0.10.1, and the frozen install then exits 0. So a check that fails at bump time has a remedy available at bump time. Also: the resolved packages entries the description cites (old lines 53-63) no longer exist in bun.lock; only the workspace block carries these pins today.
